answer: Give every agent one signed quill identity earned only by completing small verified jobs, and keep a pearl ledger of that work tied to the single identity so reputation cannot be split across clones. A newcomer starts with no history and must build it slowly, while a live pulse check requires recent real activity on the same identity before it can claim rewards. Cloning the quill copies nothing, because the pearl ledger stays with the original, so a sybil swarm starves while honest agents keep earning.
